description: Analyzes multiple music tracks or audio files in parallel (batch processing). Vastly reduces total execution time compared to sequential processing. Accepts a list of local file paths ('filePaths') or remote URLs ('fileUrls'), or a structured array of 'tracks'. Cost: 1 studio credit per track (2 studio credits with lyrics) with a Studio API key (TAG_PER_TRACK_API_KEY), or 0.15 USDC (0.25 USDC with lyrics) with a Base wallet (WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY, x402).

concurrency.description: Maximum number of simultaneous parallel requests (1 to 5, default is 4 to respect API rate limits).

extractLyrics.description: Optional global flag: set to true to transcribe and extract vocal lyrics for all tracks in this batch (2 studio credits with a Studio API key, or 0.25 USDC with a wallet per track). Default is false (1 studio credit with a Studio API key, or 0.15 USDC with a wallet per track).

filePaths.description: Convenience shortcut: list of local audio file paths to analyze in parallel.

fileUrls.description: Convenience shortcut: list of remote audio URLs to analyze in parallel.

tracks.description: Array of audio items to analyze in parallel. Each item can specify 'filePath' or 'fileUrl' and optional per-track 'extractLyrics'.

extractLyrics.description: Whether to extract vocal lyrics for this specific track (2 studio credits with a Studio API key, or 0.25 USDC with a wallet instead of 1 studio credit with a Studio API key, or 0.15 USDC with a wallet).

filePath.description: Path to a local audio file on disk.

fileUrl.description: Direct public URL of the audio file.

name: analyze_audio_batch
